# NASA Perseverance test asset

Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover. Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech.

Source: https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/mars-2020-perseverance-rover/

Download: https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/model/mars-2020-perseverance-rover/Mars%202020%20Perseverance%20Rover.glb

Usage guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

This asset is supplied for technical prototyping and is not the game's approved character design. NASA media guidelines apply; it is not labeled CC0. Preserve source acknowledgment, check third-party notices and treat NASA identifiers separately from the model media. No NASA endorsement is implied.

The original downloaded model is preserved unchanged. The file contains 88 nodes, 68 meshes and 23 animation clips, with embedded resources. It requires the KHR_draco_mesh_compression decoder. Structure was inspected; animation playback and runtime performance are not yet verified.
